acceptance_criteria: Suspected failing scan cells identified with confidence score.
method: Map FAIL_FLOP_ID -> bit position via STIL ScanLength, look up cell name, and compute calibrated composite confidence (relative dominance + pattern corroboration + obs share + fail-type consistency, blended with Logistic Regression PFA probability).

summary.confidence_definition: Per-cell: 0.50*evidence + 0.50*calibrated_GBM_PFA_prob (or 0.55/0.45 logistic fallback); evidence = 0.40*relative_dominance + 0.25*pattern_corroboration + 0.20*obs_share + 0.15*fail_type_consistency. ML: isotonic-calibrated Gradient Boosting on historical PFA confirmations. Dashboard KPI: fail-weighted mean of per-chain top-1 confidence.
